task_description: Write a method in Dafny to extract the elementwise and sequence from the given two sequence.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ElementwiseAnd(seq1: seq<bool>, seq2: seq<bool>) returns (result: seq<bool>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the result sequence should be equal to the length of the input sequences
    - Each element in the result sequence should be the logical AND of the corresponding elements in the input sequences
